title: What a lead or take-off piano player does
summary: Brownlee was a lead piano who set the tempo and key, played the intro, then played chords.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, a lead would take off and set the tempo for you, Dick.
He'd play the first chorus or something?
Play the introduction and the number, you know. And bring you right into the key you're going in and set the tempo for you. And then the trumpet man would take you from there.
What did he play in the ensemble?

Well he played chords after he took off. Yeah, after that. He didn't continue playing the lead like some guys did. No, no, no. Just a take off man. They call him a lead or take off man. Now Sam Cagliar can do the same thing with a guitar. I'm telling you, take off man, set a tempo for you that you're just as relaxed. You ought to hear that guy play, Dick.
